description: Test code for the flexvolume package, including test functions, mock setups, and utility functions for testing the flexvolume plugin.

methods.name: testPlugin
methods.description: Creates a mock flexVolumeAttachablePlugin for testing, setting up a temporary directory and plugin configuration.

methods.name: assertDriverCall
methods.description: Asserts that the correct executable, command, and arguments are used when calling the driver, and returns a fake command action.

methods.name: fakeRunner
methods.description: Creates a fake exec.Interface with a scripted sequence of fake commands for testing.

methods.name: fakeResultOutput
methods.description: Generates a fake output for a command by marshaling a result object into JSON.

methods.name: successOutput
methods.description: Returns a fake successful DriverStatus output.

methods.name: notSupportedOutput
methods.description: Returns a fake 'not supported' DriverStatus output.

methods.name: sameArgs
methods.description: Compares two slices of strings for equality.

methods.name: fakeVolumeSpec
methods.description: Creates a fake volume.Spec object with a FlexVolumeSource for testing.

methods.name: specJSON
methods.description: Serializes driver options into a JSON string for testing.
